name: California Eats: Restaurants
subtitle: Taquería & Dim Sum Guide
description:
California's restaurants, starting with the taquería.

California Eats is a free guide to eating in California: 363 taquerías, 86 burrito shops, 87 fish taco spots, 53 dim sum houses, 74 Korean barbecue restaurants, 19 burger stands and 31 wine-country restaurants we checked by hand, plus 103,294 restaurants, cafés and bars in 1,124 towns, from Los Angeles, San Francisco and San Diego to Fresno, Sacramento and Eureka. No account, no ads.

CALIFORNIA GUIDES
• Taquerías: from East LA and the Mission to San Diego taco shops, with what each one serves.
• Burritos: Mission-style burritos in the Bay Area and California burritos in San Diego.
• Fish Tacos: Baja-style fried and grilled fish tacos, mostly in San Diego County.
• Dim Sum: San Gabriel Valley halls, Chinatowns and the Bay Area.
• Korean BBQ: tabletop grills in Koreatown and across the state.
• Burger Stands and Wine Country: walk-up stands, and restaurants in Napa, Sonoma, Paso Robles and other wine towns.
• MICHELIN & James Beard: restaurants in the MICHELIN Guide California 2026 selection, and James Beard winners, finalists and semifinalists, labeled exactly as announced.
• Oldest Places: restaurants and bars open at the same address since 1960 or earlier, oldest first.
• Inspections: official results from Los Angeles County (score and A/B/C grade), San Francisco and Sacramento County, shown as each county records them.

FIND IT FAST
• Sort by distance, or browse the map by taquerías, dim sum, burritos, Korean BBQ or honors.
• Search by name, town, street or dish: "al pastor oakland", "dim sum monterey park".
• Filter by region, town or cuisine, hide chains.
• Save places, and find hand-checked places from iPhone search (Spotlight).

LIVE DETAILS FROM APPLE MAPS
Tap "Ratings, hours & photos" on any place to open Apple Maps' own place card, with current hours, photos, ratings and directions.

HOW THE LISTS ARE BUILT
Every place in the taquería, burrito, fish taco, dim sum, Korean barbecue, burger stand and wine-country guides was checked by hand in October 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source: its own website, menu or ordering page, or dated local news. The rest of the restaurants come from Overture Maps open data, county food-facility records and California ABC license data, checked for reliability against those records. Website links are checked too. Nothing is ranked by star ratings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your location, if you share it, only sorts lists on your device. Saved places stay on your device.

Places open and close, so check before you go. Spot a mistake? Email nick@eatsranked.com.

An independent app, not affiliated with any restaurant, chain or government agency (including the County of Los Angeles, the City and County of San Francisco, Sacramento County and California ABC), or with Michelin or the James Beard Foundation. MICHELIN and the MICHELIN Guide are trademarks of Michelin. James Beard Foundation and James Beard Award are trademarks of the James Beard Foundation. Place data from Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA Permissive 2.0) and others; sources and licenses are on the About tab.

reviewNotes:
1. Purpose and audience: California Eats is a free guide to restaurants in California. Its focus is the state's food traditions: 363 taquerías, 86 burrito shops, 87 fish taco spots, 53 dim sum houses, 74 Korean barbecue restaurants, 19 burger stands and 31 wine-country restaurants, each checked by hand in October 2026 against a 2025 or 2026 source: the restaurant's own website, menu or ordering page, or dated local news. It also lists 103,294 restaurants, cafés and bars statewide, MICHELIN and James Beard honors as announced, and official health inspection results from three counties. It is for California residents and visitors deciding where to eat. No ads, account or tracking.

2. How to use it (no login, no setup, no sample files needed):
- Home → Taquerías (or Burritos, Fish Tacos, Dim Sum, Korean BBQ, Burger Stands, Wine Country, MICHELIN & James Beard, Oldest Places, Inspections, Near Me, All Restaurants) → tap any place.
- On a place, tap "Ratings, hours & photos" to open Apple Maps' own place card through MapKit. Directions, Call and Website are below it.
- Search from the Home search box by name, town, street or dish ("al pastor oakland", "dim sum monterey park").
- The Map tab shows each guide as pins. "My location" and the Nearest sort use location only if allowed, on the device.
- The heart saves a place on the device (Saved tab). About lists the sources, licenses and independence statement.
- On iPad, a sidebar replaces the tabs; a place opens in the right-hand column.
- Outside California, the map says so and stays on California; distance sorting still works.
- "CA Eats" is the short Home Screen name of "California Eats: Restaurants".

3. External services and data:
- Apple MapKit: maps, local search to find a place's Apple Maps listing, and Apple's place card for live hours, photos and ratings.
- Core Location: optional, on-device only, for distance sorting.
- Core Spotlight: on-device indexing so places appear in iPhone search.
- No backend, accounts, analytics, advertising, payments or AI services. The restaurant data is bundled in the app.
- Bundled data: Overture Maps Foundation open place data (CDLA Permissive 2.0; Foursquare records Apache 2.0, AllThePlaces CC0; license texts in the app); public food-facility and inspection records of Los Angeles County, San Francisco, Sacramento County and San Diego County; California ABC license data; MICHELIN's and the James Beard Foundation's announcements (facts only); and our own research of restaurants' websites, menus and local news.
- The website with the privacy policy and support page is static and hosted on GitHub Pages: https://nickstrom5.github.io/california-eats/

4. Regional differences: none. The content covers California; the app is offered in the United States and works the same everywhere.

5. Regulated or protected material: the app is not in a regulated industry and includes no protected third-party material. The data is open-licensed or public record, with attribution and licenses on the About tab. Ratings, hours and photos appear only inside Apple's own place card through MapKit; the app stores no ratings or reviews. Inspection results are each county's own (LA County's score and letter grade, San Francisco's and Sacramento County's placard results), labeled official and dated; the app never computes its own grades. MICHELIN and James Beard honors are stated as announced, with trademark notices. Restaurant names are factual references. Every website link was checked before release, and adult venues are excluded. The app is independent and not affiliated with any restaurant, agency, Michelin or the James Beard Foundation.
